QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] Royal Decoy
QuestInfo.1: Miriam wants to tell you something shocking.
QuestInfo.2: Miriam is a decoy! The real princess is in another cas... somewhere else. She's somewhere else.

0.0: I can't take this anymore! #h0#, I have a horrible secret... I'm no princess!\r\n#L0##bYou're not the princess?#l\n#k
0.1: We still don't know what happened to the king, and we wanted to keep the princess safe, so they made me put on this fancy dress and pretend to be the princess instead. But I'm just a maid! Trust me, I don't wanna be a princess!\r\n#L0##bWhere's the real princess, then?#l\n#k
0.2: I-I can't tell you that! What if you're a bad person? Oh no, I shouldn't have spilled my guts to you just now! Parma's coming back... Quick, act like you don't know nothing!

no.0: C'mon, Parma's almost here. I shouldn't be talking to you!

yes.0: You were nice to me. I appreciate that, I really do. If you really wanna help, save Kritias!
